messages:
maria: Heads up — pen test inbound Wed 2026-04-12. Need to confirm RBAC windows, KMS evidence handoff, and retest criteria. Quick sync?

alex: Can we narrow scope to staging + dedicated infra? Assessor needs read-only access to logs and ephemeral admin for 2h.

jen: @alex + @sam — propose ephemeral role `pt_assessor` via SCIM for 2026-04-12 14:00-16:00. Will that map to our KMS proxy?

sam: Yes. We'll provision through iam-service with presigned creds. Steps: 1) create role, 2) set policy, 3) generate presigned creds. Example CLI: ```aws iam create-role --role-name pt_assessor --assume-role-policy-file trust.json```

maria: We need audit log export retention snapshot and sample query. Assessor wants authz decision logs + request traces. Sam — can you attach a short sample query we can hand over?

sam: Sure. For ES query: ```GET /redwood-logs/_search { "query": { "bool": { "must": [ {"term": {"event":"authz_decision"}}, {"range": {"@timestamp":{"gte":"now-30d"}}} ]}}```

jen: Also, evidence packaging: prefer S3 presigned + hash manifest. We'll generate manifest.json with SHA256. Ops-runbook will list twice-signed handoff (ops + security).

maria: Remediation tracking: use vuln-triage board, tag with `pt:high` and include `retest_required` label. Retest window is 7 days after submit. Who owns verification?

alex: I'll take verification for infra vulns. @jen will triage app-level.

jen: I can do app triage. For severity mapping, we use CVSS >=7 = critical; anything else gets scheduled.

sam: One more — KMS integration. Assessor will need to access wrapped data samples. We can create an unwrap service that logs every unwrap event to audit-log index and adds `x-assessor-id`. CLI snippet to generate ephemeral grant: ```aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/redwood-pt --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/pt_assessor --operations Decrypt```

sec-bot: Reminder: create JIRA PT ticket and attach manifest, roles, evidence links. Auto ticket will be generated when checklist is complete.

maria: Checklist for go-live: 1) Role created 2) Evidence snapshot 3) Presigned URLs sent 4) Audit queries validated 5) Retest ticket created.

alex: :thumbsup: Can we schedule a 15m pre-window call on Monday? I'll send calendar invite.

jen: Also, rollback/rollforward: if remediation causes behavior break, we do feature-flag rollback + hotfix branch. Document will be in internal docs (/docs/pt-runbook).

sam: I'll run a dry-run tomorrow at 09:00 and post the logs here.

maria: Perfect. Assign owners in the board and @mention when done. Thanks everyone.
